command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
cmake --version
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
cmake --build out/build/windows-msvc-x64 --config Debug --target ForgeConductor.Contracts.ContractTests ForgeConductor.Infrastructure.HeaderSelfContainment ForgeConductor.Infrastructure.ProjectWorkspaceAuthorityTests ForgeConductor.Infrastructure.UnitTests ForgeConductor.NativeTools.HeaderSelfContainment ForgeConductor.NativeTools.GitShellTests ForgeConductor.NativeTools.GitShellIntegrationTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ExecutionServicesTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ClientWorkspaceContextTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ToolPackAdapterTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ToolContractMatrixTests ForgeConductor.Mcp.ServeProcessSnapshotTests ForgeConductor.Continuity.LegacyApplicationTests --parallel
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
ctest --test-dir out/build/windows-msvc-x64 -C Debug --output-on-failure -R '^(ForgeConductor\.Contracts\.ContractTests|ForgeConductor\.Infrastructure\.HeaderSelfContainment|ForgeConductor\.Infrastructure\.ProjectWorkspaceAuthorityTests|ForgeConductor\.Infrastructure\.UnitTests|ForgeConductor\.NativeTools\.HeaderSelfContainment|ForgeConductor\.NativeTools\.GitShellTests|ForgeConductor\.NativeTools\.GitShellIntegrationTests|ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.ExecutionServicesTests|ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.ClientWorkspaceContextTests|ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.ToolPackAdapterTests|ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.ToolContractMatrixTests|ForgeConductor\.Mcp\.ServeProcessSnapshotTests|ForgeConductor\.Continuity\.LegacyApplicationTests)$'
exit $LASTEXITCODE
